usage.not: An icon button with a hover hint
usage.why: On phones, hover hints never show; a word says what will happen.
Visitors come rarely, so they never learn an icon. A word says what will happen.

usage.not: A thin icon at text size
usage.why: Larger icons hold their own next to big type. The thicker line carries the brand's warmth.

stroke-width.$description: The line weight of every icon, on Lucide's 24px grid.
